name: Push
description: Push for every app on this server: Web Push for browsers, and native push for mobile apps (APNs on iOS, FCM and UnifiedPush on Android). Each app's keys and credentials come from its CI with NOOK_TOKEN; devices subscribe and get a handle anyone can notify, now or at a set time. Built for local-first apps with no backend of their own.

env.desc: A mailto: address push services can reach you at, like mailto:you@example.com
Pushes one handle can get an hour, sent and scheduled together
Web Push services beyond the usual ones, comma-separated: your own ntfy's host, for UnifiedPush on Android
